warning.titlePre: Land Rover Freelander 2.0 Td4 Timing Chain & Injector Seal Wear
paragraphs: If your Freelander is a later Td4 model with the BMW M47D20 diesel engine, timing chain stretch and injector seal leaks are a well-documented pattern on this engine — shared with BMW 3 and 5 Series of the same era. We replace the timing chain, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M47D20 rebuild.
The early 2.0 Di models used a different engine, the L-Series, which does not share this specific timing chain pattern.
warning.source: Source: BMW M47 pattern, shared with BMW 3/5 Series of same era, per G-BRF and VRF. L-Series engine explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to engine code
